notes.title: Little Ninja 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Fixed level 2 dialog issues
2. Fixed mixing issues on credit scene
3. Removed playback look after playing the piano
4. Added #1 Fan to the credits
5. Updated QR Code in credits
6. Player now fades when hiding behind objects
7. Player can turn on and off lamps
8. Provided the MigMig's with a dental plan
9. Other misc bug fixes
